cohort: 120 pregnant women with oligohydramnios (amniotic fluid index <= 5cm) at >34 weeks gestation and 120 pregnant women with normal amniotic fluid index (8-24cm) at >34 weeks gestation.
finding: Pregnancies complicated by oligohydramnios at or beyond 34 weeks of gestation are associated with increased rates of non-reactive NST, FHR deceleration during labor, fetal distress, cesarean delivery, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was higher in the oligohydramnios group (54.17%) compared to the control group (19.17%).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was lower in the oligohydramnios group (2.4 kg) compared to the control group (2.9 kg), and 61.67% of infants in the oligohydramnios group had a birth weight <2.5 kg compared to 17.5% in the control group.
